MemberInfo GetMemberInfo<TValue>(Expression<Func<TValue>> accessor)\n27:     {\n28:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(accessor);\n29: \n30:         return _memberInfoCache.GetOrAdd(accessor, static expr =>\n31:         {\n32:             var lambdaExpression = (LambdaExpression)expr;\n33:             var accessorBody = lambdaExpression.Body;\n34: \n35:             if (accessorBody is UnaryExpression unaryExpression\n36:                 && unaryExpression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Convert\n37:                 && unaryExpression.Type == typeof(object))\n38:             {\n39: (fields, properties) of an object are supported.\");\n47:             }\n48: \n49:             return memberExpression.Member;\n50:         });\n51:     }\n52: \n53:     public static string GetDisplayName(MemberInfo member)\n54:     {\n55:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(member);\n56: \n57:         return _displayNameCache.GetOrAdd(member, static m =>\n58:         {\n59:             var displayAttribute = m.GetCustomAttribute<DisplayAttribute>();\n60:             if (displayAttribute is not null)\n61:             {\n62:                 var name = displayAttribute.GetName();\n63:                 if (name is not null)\n64:                 {\n65:                     return name;\n66:                 }\n67:             }\n68: \n69:             var displayNameAttribute.DisplayName;\n73:             }\n74: \n75:             return m.Name;\n76:         });\n77:     }\n78: \n79:     public static string This may correspond to a property on a\\n15: /// model object, or can be any other named value.\\n16: /// </summary>\\n17: public readonly struct FieldIdentifier : IEquatable<FieldIdentifier>\\n18: {\\n19:     private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<(Type ModelType, MemberInfo Member), Func<object, object>> _fieldAccessors = new();\\n20: \\n21:     static FieldIdentifier()\\n22:     {\\n23:         if (HotReloadManager.Default.MetadataUpdateSupported)\\n24:         {\\n25:             HotReloadManager.Default.OnDeltaApplied += ClearCache;\\n26:         }\\n27:     }\\n28: \\n29:     /// <summary>\\n30:     /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref=\\\"FieldIdentifier\\\"/> structure.\\n31:     /// </summary>\\n32:     /// <param name=\\\"accessor\\\">An expression that identifies an object member.</param>\\n33:     /// <typeparam name=\\\"TField\\\">The field <see cref=\\\"Type\\\"/>.</typeparam>\\n34:     public static FieldIdentifier Create<TField>(Expression<Func<TField>> accessor)\\n35:     {\\n36:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(accessor);\\n37: \\n38:         ParseAccessor(accessor, out var model, out var fieldName);\\n39:         return new FieldIdentifier(model, fieldName);\\n40:     }\\n41: \\n42:     /// <summary>\\n43:     /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref=\\\"FieldIdentifier\\\"/> structure.\\n44:     /// </summary>\\n45:     /// <param name=\\\"model\\\">The object that owns the field.</param>\\n46:     /// <param name=\\\"fieldName\\\">The name of the editable field.</param>\\n47:     public FieldIdentifier(object model, string fieldName)\\n48:     {\\n49:         ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(model);\\n50: \\n51:         if (model.GetType().IsValueType)\\n52:         {\\n53:             throw new ArgumentException(\\\"The model must be a reference-typed object.\\\", nameof(model));\\n54:         }\\n55: \\n56:         Model = model;\\n57: \\n58:         // Note that we do allow an empty string. This is used by some validation systems\\n59:         // as a place to store object-level (not per-property) messages.\\n60:         FieldName = fieldName ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(fieldName));\\n61:     }\\n62: \\n63:     /// <summary>\\n64:     /// Gets the object that owns the editable field.\\n65:     /// </summary>\\n66:     public object Model { get; }\\n67: \\n68:     /// <summary>\\n69:     /// Gets the name of the editable field.\\n70:     /// </summary>\\n71:     public string FieldName { get; }\\n72: \\n73:     /// <inheritdoc />\\n74:     public override int GetHashCode()\\n75:     {\\n76:         // We want to compare Model instances by reference. RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode returns identical hashes for equal object references (ignoring any `Equals`/`GetHashCode` overrides) which is what we want.\\n77:         var modelHash = RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(Model);\\n78:         var fieldHash = StringComparer.Ordinal.GetHashCode(FieldName);\\n79:         return (\\n80:             modelHash,\\n81:             fieldHash\\n82:         )\\n83:         .GetHashCode();\\n84:     }\\n85: \\n86:     /// <inheritdoc />\\n87:     public override bool Equals(object? obj)\\n88:         => obj is FieldIdentifier otherIdentifier\\n89:         && Equals(otherIdentifier);\\n90: \\n91:     /// <inheritdoc />\\n92:     public bool Equals(FieldIdentifier otherIdentifier)\\n93:     {\\n94:         return ReferenceEquals(otherIdentifier.Model, Model) &&\\n95:             string.Equals(otherIdentifier.FieldName, FieldName, StringComparison.Ordinal);\\n96:     }\\n97: \\n98:     private static void ParseAccessor<T>(Expression<Func<T>> accessor, out object model, out string fieldName)\\n99:     {\\n100:         var accessorBody = accessor.Body;\\n101: \\n102:         // Unwrap casts to object\\n103:         if (accessorBody is UnaryExpression unaryExpression\\n104:             && unaryExpression.NodeType == ExpressionType.Convert\\n105:             && unaryExpression.Type == typeof(object))\\n106:         {\\n107:             accessorBody = unaryExpression.Operand;\\n108:         }\\n109: \\n110:         switch (accessorBody)\\n111:         {\\n112:             case MemberExpression memberExpression:\\n113:                 // Identify the field name. We don't mind whether it's a property or field, or even something else.\\n114:                 fieldName = memberExpression.Member.Name;\\n115:                 // Get a reference to the model object\\n116:                 // i.e., given a value like \\\"(something).MemberName\\\", determine the runtime value of \\\"(something)\\\",\\n117:                 switch (memberExpression.Expression)\\n118:                 {\\n119:                     case ConstantExpression constant when constant.Value == null:\\n120:                         throw new ArgumentException(\\\"The provided expression must evaluate to a non-null value.\\\");\\n121:                     case ConstantExpression constant when constant.Value != null:\\n122:                         model = constant.Value;\\n123:                         break;\\n124:                     case MemberExpression member when member.Expression is ConstantExpression:\\n125:                         model = GetModelFromMemberAccess(member);\\n126:                         break;\\n127:                     case not null:\\n128:                         // It would be great to cache this somehow, but it's unclear there's a reasonable way to do\\n129:                         // so, given that it embeds captured values such as \\\"this\\\". We could consider special-casing\\n130:                         // for \\\"() => something.Member\\\" and building a cache keyed by \\\"something.GetType()\\\" with values\\n131:                         // of type Func<object, object> so we can cheaply map from \\\"something\\\" to \\\"something.Member\\\".\\n132:                         var modelLambda = Expression.Lambda(typeof(Func<object?>),
